subject.title: style(android): apply ktlint to landed changes

question: Should this PR be narrowed back to the Android ktlint cleanup, closed and recreated, or intentionally reviewed as a broad cross-repo change set?
rationale: The intended cleanup is useful, but the current conflicting head includes automation, auth/provider, compatibility, and user-facing changes that cannot be accepted as incidental formatting drift.

options.title: Rebase to Android-only scope
options.body: Keep the useful cleanup by rebuilding this branch on current main with only Android formatting and matching native i18n inventory, then refresh exact-head proof.

options.title: Close and recreate narrowly
options.body: Close this branch if it cannot be cleaned up quickly, and open a fresh PR containing only the intended ktlint and generated-inventory changes.

options.title: Review as a broad PR
options.body: If maintainers intentionally want the cross-repo diff, require full owner, security, upgrade, and real-behavior proof review before merge.

recommendation.title: Rebase to Android-only scope
recommendation.body: Keep the useful cleanup by rebuilding this branch on current main with only Android formatting and matching native i18n inventory, then refresh exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current branch and has the strongest recent history across the Android, native setup, generated inventory, and autoreview surfaces involved in the scope decision.
